paper.title: Neuralized Fermionic Tensor Networks for Quantum Many-Body Systems
paper.authors: Si-Jing Du, Ao Chen, Garnet Kin-Lic Chan

results.system_description: 4x4 square lattice, open boundaries; U/t = 8; half filling, 16 electrons (8 up, 8 down)
results.source_location: SM S-5, Table tab:4x4_half_energy, row NN-fPEPS-GO, column D = 4
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy per site of a neural-network-augmented fermionic tensor network (NN-fTNS, configuration-dependent fPEPS/fMPS tensors from a neural network) optimized by gradient-based VMC, for the Fermi-Hubbard model with OBC at U = 8.
results.notes: Printed as energy ± error (for example -0.42535\pm ...); the energy token is the number and the uncertainty the printed ± value. A hybrid of a fermionic tensor network and a neural network. The pure fPEPS/fMPS rows of the same table are tensor-network results, and the NN backflow baselines in the caption have no error bars. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
